rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable braking-zone definition replacing the previously unspecified dangerous-zone boundary. Per the baseline, H1-CRD3 and H1-ORR3 depend on FR-7.1 and on the dangerous-zone definition for distinguishing braking-relevant distance classes. This changes the required Concern-Relevant Distinction for the spatial/distance aspect of the phenomenon, while the Evaluation Target and overall Phenomenon of Interest remain the same. Therefore the derivation must resume at RR3 rather than merely revalidating existing ORRs.
